no-restricted-globals.name: localStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: This frame's own storage is lost when its origin is cleared and is never backed up: what the player chooses goes to Exo through the host (saved.ts); a convenience goes through frameStore.ts, under a key named there with why it may be lost.
